title: l9.product-birth-binding/v1
description: The exact coordinates a caller claims when binding an already-resolved product realization to one repository birth: product id and kind as resolved upstream, the ProductManifest and ProductTopology references and digests the manifest carries, the realized source snapshot, the l9.repo-birth-contract/v1 and l9.birth-payload/v1 artifacts by digest, and the factory revision. It is input to l9_birth_adapter.py, which holds every coordinate to the artifacts themselves. It is a closed shape: no repository shape, no kind hint, no inferred field is admitted, because the adapter never infers ProductKind or reads a source tree. Semantic refs and digests (manifest, topology) are owned upstream and are opaque non-empty strings here; artifact digests (birth contract, payload) are the factory convention `sha256:` over the artifact bytes.

product.description: Restates the product coordinates the manifest resolves. The adapter compares them; it never supplies them.

manifest.description: The exact ProductManifest: its semantic ref and the semantic digest it declares as manifest_digest. Compared as opaque strings; never recomputed here.

topology.description: The exact ProductTopology the manifest records as source_topology.

source.description: The realized source snapshot the birth contract and the compiled payload both bind.

payload.description: The exact compiled l9.birth-payload/v1 artifact the birth contract references.

factory.description: The exact birth factory the realization is bound to. Explicit, never defaulted.
